newsitem.title: USA: Euro must not be weak -UK's Blair.
newsitem.headline: Euro must not be weak -UK's Blair.

text.p: The European Union's planned single currency must not be weak, British Prime Minister Tony Blair said on Sunday.
"We cannot have a Europe that is either closed and protectionist or a Europe that has a single currency that is a weak currency," Blair told ABC television.
He said it was important that EU leaders agreed at their summit last week in Amsterdam not to weaken the criteria for the single currency, due to be launched in 1999.

Britain has the right to opt out of the single currency, and Blair has said it is extremely unlikely to join in the first wave. But he said on Sunday that he expected Britain would qualify if it wanted to join.
